explication: capa is a malware-capability analyzer: the CLI accepts executable samples or sandbox reports, selects an extractor, evaluates extracted features against rules, and presents capability results. Static analysis has multiple backend integrations; dynamic analysis consumes reports. Results can also be frozen or explored interactively in the browser, and IDA/Ghidra plugins provide analyst-facing integrations. Some subsystem links are documented only at a high level; the graph avoids asserting unshown calls.
